accepted_judges.accepted_scope: mpeg_timing unit builds a synthetic 640x480/code-4 stream with stuffing, STD, audio, PTS and PTS+DTS, verifies two video timestamps and 10 s plus one truncated frame; rejects MPEG-2 pack, broken length and absent PTS. Registered gate invocation additionally reads local RE-US.MPG.
accepted_judges.limits: Historical accepted path only, not rerun. This does not independently recover DirectShow duration/EC_COMPLETE policy or validate decoder/audio/hardware behavior. Marker validity, PTS wrap, split sequence headers, other rate codes and malformed tails are not established by this unit. ISO table comment is source attribution, not a spec verification performed here.

resolved.resolution: MpegTiming is a result value and the parser has local state only plus immutable rate data. HleDshow Graph owns optional duration, run-start/position and completion queue. Its unknown duration before AddSourceFilter is graph lifecycle absence. Native MoviePlayer separately owns AVFoundation samples/timeline and audio presentation state.

destination: Retain this bounded reference-purpose responsibility; any future relocation is organizational work, not recovered game logic progress.
reason: Reference DirectShow metadata timing helper, with uncaptured splitter policy explicitly assumed by its sole runtime caller; excluded from actual native movie/import paths.

resolved_consumers.resolution: Only maintained non-test direct parser caller is HLE AddSourceFilter: reads mapped host movie, stops on parser failure, stores duration and reports the uncaptured splitter assumption. stream_time/deliver_due/get_Duration consume that value, including EC_COMPLETE. Native app opens MoviePlayer on imported paths; completion uses decoder EOS, audio presentation frames and AVFoundation track end. Importer copies/hashes movie bytes and extracts clip/playlist declarations with separate Python PEImage; it never calls this C++ parser.

semantic_review.semantic_justification: Complete header and implementation reviewed: local timing accumulator, 33-bit timestamp extraction, MPEG-1 pack/system/packet walk, E0 video filtering, stuffing/STD skips, PTS/PTS+DTS payload offsets, min/max timestamp aggregation, first in-packet sequence header size/rate decode and truncated integer conversion to 100 ns plus one frame. Format start codes, stream IDs, masks and rate fractions are numeric encodings, not addresses. Optional result means unsupported/malformed/missing stream metadata. There are no fixture-availability state members or recovered game branches. The duration formula is the reference HLE duration assumption, not recovered DirectShow splitter behavior. Actual use is AddSourceFilter in hle_dshow; it is neither native movie playback nor the importer despite the loader directory and generated asset-boundary label. Dense implementation still needs readability cleanup.
